snippet.title: Pinetrail | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

Pinetrail releases on the following platforms:
- Steam  on Q2 2027 - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4920240

NO AI was used in making of this game (last we checked steam, according the devs)

Popular descriptions: Casual, Action-Adventure, 3D, First-Person, Stylized

Pinetrail is a single player game.
Developed & published by Dimitris Kartakis


Check more upcoming trailers from https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXPLuh7Rmt-uU_6hHJXZUq6Z539FOpMrx
